subject.title: fix(node): fail closed on invalid trusted-proxy CIDRs and warn on untrusted forwarding

question: Should this PR be accepted as diagnostics-only while https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/1008 remains open, or must it also prevent the OAuth source-bucket availability attack before merging?
rationale: The patch improves observability but intentionally leaves the vulnerable admission and source-identity behavior unchanged, so only maintainers can decide whether diagnostics are an independently mergeable scope or an insufficient security resolution.

options.title: Land as diagnostics-only
options.body: Remove the closing claim, preserve blank-as-unset compatibility, add live proof, and keep the canonical issue open for the actual mitigation.

options.title: Require complete mitigation
options.body: Expand the patch with a maintainer-approved admission or source-identity strategy that prevents one proxy bucket from blocking all downstream users.

recommendation.title: Land as diagnostics-only
recommendation.body: Remove the closing claim, preserve blank-as-unset compatibility, add live proof, and keep the canonical issue open for the actual mitigation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person most directly to the current OAuth admission and trusted-source implementation, though final security acceptance still requires repository authority.
